stories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh makes first hires at central bank, including ‘Project 2025’ author
stories.body: The new Fed chair has made his first hires. One wrote the Fed chapter in conservative policy blueprint "Project 2025."

stories.headline: Texas Instruments Appoints Julie Knecht To Succeed Rafael Lizardi As CFO
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Texas Instruments Inc. (TXN) announced that it has appointed Julie Knecht as chief financial officer, effective August 1, 2026. Knecht succeeds Rafael Lizardi, who will retire after 25 years with the company. Lizardi will provide continued support in an advisory role

stories.headline: ChatGPT Hits 1 Billion Users Faster Than Any App in History
stories.body: OpenAI’s ChatGPT app reached 1 billion global monthly active users faster than any other app, Reuters reported Tuesday (June 2), citing data from Sensor Tower.
